project_type: Vite React SPA (frontend) + FastAPI BFF (backend) - Manga translator
build_system: Vite + npm for frontend, FastAPI for backend
test_framework: Vitest for frontend (not required for this sprint)
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to verify no type errors and clean build
environment_constraints: No tests required per user rules. Must pass typecheck and build before push.
contribution_requirements: Create branch feature/alpha-sprint7 from current HEAD. Commit, push, open PR against main. Do NOT create version tag.
key_patterns: Zustand stores with persist middleware in store/, React components in components/, feature modules in features/, backend Pydantic schemas in backend/app/schemas/, providers in backend/app/providers/. CamelModel base class for Pydantic models. PipelineOptions carries options from frontend to backend.
directory_structure: Root: Vite React app with store/, features/, components/, services/, types.ts. Backend: backend/app/ with routers/, providers/, schemas/, services/.
